intro.text: Emergency! The giant carnival balloon escaped with the birthday cake! It has a better seat than I do.
intro.speaker: kabir

shock.text: We have to save it before the candles become shooting stars. Look! The wind is blowing east.
shock.speaker: meher

banner.text: Today's programme: music at noon, cake at one. Please do not launch the cake into outer space.
banner.speaker: baldev

kabir.text: The cake is still safe in the basket. If we repair our spare balloon, we can catch up.
kabir.speaker: kabir

meher.text: The flags are pointing east. A gentle east breeze is perfect; a wild gust will flip us.
meher.speaker: meher

baldev.text: I was watching the balloon. Then I sneezed and it stole the entire cake! Even the cherry.
baldev.speaker: baldev

workshopWelcome.text: Welcome to my invention tent. Take a patch and safety rope, then tune the fan gently.
workshopWelcome.speaker: meena

meena.text: Safety first! A good repair, a strong rope, and a gentle fan. No shortcuts.
meena.speaker: meena

rohan.text: I made a fan with three settings. Soft breeze, giant gust, and absolutely nothing.
rohan.speaker: rohan

fabric.text: Brilliant pink fabric! This will fix the tear in our rescue balloon.
fabric.speaker: rohan

rope.text: A proper safety rope. Attach it before the balloon lifts, or we'll be chasing another one.
rope.speaker: meena

fanQuestion.text: What fan setting makes a calm, safe balloon launch?
fanQuestion.speaker: rohan

fanRetry.text: That won't give us a steady launch. Pick the gentle breeze.
fanRetry.speaker: meena

fanDone.text: Perfect! The fan purrs like a sleepy kitten. And nobody lost their eyebrows.
fanDone.speaker: rohan

needParts.text: We need a patch, safety rope and a tuned fan. Visit Meena's repair tent.
needParts.speaker: harpreet

readyForField.text: Great teamwork! We've got the fabric, rope and fan ready. Let's head to the launch field.
readyForField.speaker: harpreet

launchIntro.text: Big balloon. Tiny basket. I vote we check every safety step before takeoff.
launchIntro.speaker: kabir

needPatch.text: The balloon has a tear. Use the pink patch from your pocket on the balloon.
needPatch.speaker: meena

patched.text: Patch secured. That's one less hole between us and the clouds.
patched.speaker: meena

needRope.text: Now fasten the safety rope! Tap it in your pocket, then tap the balloon.
needRope.speaker: rohan

tethered.text: Tied tight! That knot could hold Baldev's whole tea collection.
tethered.speaker: rohan

chooseWind.text: Which wind will carry us steadily toward the cake?
chooseWind.speaker: meher

windRetry.text: Watch the carnival flags. They point east, so the safe breeze is east.
windRetry.speaker: meher

windDone.text: East wind confirmed. A beautiful day for a sky-high cake delivery.
windDone.speaker: meher

boardHint.text: Balloon repaired, rope attached and gentle east wind selected. All aboard!
boardHint.speaker: harpreet

launch.text: We're flying! Please tell the ground I left my sandwich in the workshop.
launch.speaker: kabir

skyIntro.text: Whoa! Look at those rainbow clouds. And the runaway cake is right beside us!
skyIntro.speaker: meher

skyKabir.text: We must catch it gently. I can reach the basket using our safety rope.
skyKabir.speaker: kabir

cloud.text: That cloud looks like a giant doughnut. I think I'm hungry.
cloud.speaker: meher

netHint.text: We can hold our rescue net under the cake. First, secure its basket with the rope.
netHint.speaker: meena

cakeChoice.text: How should we catch the cake without dropping it?
cakeChoice.speaker: kabir

cakeRetry.text: Safe rescuers stay in their balloon. Use the rope to pull the other basket close.
cakeRetry.speaker: harpreet

cakeCaught.text: Got it! Cake secured in the rescue net. Not a single cherry lost.
cakeCaught.speaker: meena

needCake.text: Not yet! We can't go home without the cake. Tap the runaway basket first.
needCake.speaker: kabir

finalHero.text: Mission complete! Today we proved teamwork is stronger than the wind.
finalHero.speaker: harpreet

finalMeher.text: Best cake delivery ever. It came with a free flight!
finalMeher.speaker: meher

finalKabir.text: Can I have the first slice? I've been emotionally supporting that cake for miles.
finalKabir.speaker: kabir

finalBaldev.text: Nobody touch the candles. I sneezed once and nearly sent the icing to the moon!
finalBaldev.speaker: baldev

saveResume.text: Welcome back, pilot. Our flying cake still needs you.
saveResume.speaker: kabir

cantCombine.text: Try attaching the patch or rope to the rescue balloon. Other items won't stick.
cantCombine.speaker: meena
